title: United States labor market facets (recent official figures)
description: Each entry is a Facet of the US labor market — one face of the working substrate at a chosen angle (turnover, hours, pay). Where /2 (Structures) held stock figures (participation, employment), /3 (Facets) holds the flow/quality faces the same market presents. Real, dated, sourced figures — not placeholders.

primary_sources: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics — Job Openings and Labor Turnover Survey (JOLTS), bls.gov
U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics — Current Employment Statistics (CES), bls.gov
provenance.note: Each facet carries its own source and period. These are OBSERVED published statistics; ASSOCIATION != CAUSATION.
